description: Free. For one product ('price', 'candles', 'derivatives', 'positioning', 'liquidity', 'snapshot', 'funding', 'oi-movers', 'crowded', 'whales', 'liquidations', 'volatility', 'options', 'similar-setups', 'leadership', 'venues', 'history', 'network', 'fees', 'signals', 'metrics', 'compute', 'compute-large', 'news', 'ask', 'brief', 'watch'), the exact URL to call with your x402 client, HTTP method, price, declared inputs and an example response. Pass `query` (e.g. {"asset": "SOL"}) to get the URL with those inputs filled in and checked. Use this right before paying; it never charges or returns the live data itself.
